Mia (product): quick sync — we need a tight PRD for the cap semantics on per-tenant limits. customers expect a soft cap + hard cap combo, and billing team needs clear meter triggers.
Sam (eng): can you outline the behavioral differences you expect when hitting soft vs hard cap? throttling vs rejection?
Mia (product): soft cap = notify + throttled responses (graceful degradation, prioritized traffic). hard cap = 429s and no further billing beyond committed capacity. Acceptance criteria: must be configurable per-tenant, observable in console, and expose API for current usage and cap.
Lena (billing): two billing implications: 1) metered overage (pay-as-you-go) after soft cap OR 2) pause and charge only reserved commit. Need option flags. Also need clear invoice line items for overages. We need sample CSV export format.
Sam (eng): implementation questions: do we enforce at gateway or at runtime backends? Prefer gateway for early rejection and simpler accounting. Gateway can emit events: `cap_hit.soft` and `cap_hit.hard` with tenant_id and usage buckets.
Olga (legal): for enterprise customers that required data residency / audit, hard cap must be enforceable and auditable. Provide exportable audit logs for any cap enforcement decision.
Mia (product): scope negotiation: MVP should support: per-tenant soft/hard config, UI controls in console, API to read/update caps, realtime metrics, billing flag to choose overage vs pause. Deferred: quotas spanning multiple projects/orgs, rate-sculpting by route.
Sam (eng): acceptance criteria draft:
- API: GET /v1/tenants/:id/limits returns {soft, hard, mode}
- Enforcement: soft cap results in 10% request shedding and response header `X-Redwood-Limit-Status: soft`; hard cap returns 429 + `X-Redwood-Limit-Status: hard`
- Billing: events emitted within 5s of cap crossing; invoice line description: `overage: tokens beyond soft cap - tenant`.
Lena (billing): edge cases: clock drift between services, duplicate events, and pro-rated daily caps. Need idempotency keys on events and a deduper in billing pipeline.
Sam (eng): worth adding simple retry/backoff header for clients when throttled: `Retry-After` seconds. Also add a canary flag for 5 customers first rollout.
Mia (product): launch criteria: docs + SDK examples, console controls, UI tests, E2E with billing pipeline, 2-week canary with rollback plan. Owners: Sam (eng) impl, Lena (billing) billing pipelines, Olga (legal) compliance checklist.
Raj (devops-bot): deploy scheduled: canary rollout window set for 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Mia (product): thanks — I'll turn this into a PRD draft and ping for review tomorrow. Any objections to the scope above?
Lena (billing): looks good, pls add CSV schema. 
Sam (eng): +1. I'll add API contract in the RFC.
Olga (legal): ok from legal, need audit log sample.
Mia (product): will include. Closing thread for now — will link PRD when ready.
